summary.goal: Dispatch auditor agents to verify worker output against acceptance criteria. Auditors review code, run tests, and check that produced artifacts meet the defined criteria.

acceptance_criteria.description: spawnAuditor(taskId, artifacts, criteria) creates verification agent
Auditor receives read-only workspace access (no commits)
Auditor prompt includes artifacts produced and acceptance criteria
Auditor reports pass/fail via report_audit_result MCP tool (defined in forge-mcp-tools)
Failed audit transitions task to failed state with findings
Task can be retried after failed audit (worker re-spawned with findings)
Audit findings stored in task_attempts.audit_findings

observations: Auditors are separate from workers - different prompt, different role
Read-only access prevents auditor from 'fixing' issues
Auditor sees: what was produced + what was expected
Detailed findings help worker on retry
report_audit_result MCP tool defined in forge-mcp-tools
patterns: Auditor uses same relay spawn as worker, different prompt
Findings stored as JSONB for UI display
concerns: Auditor hallucinating pass/fail - consider structured output format

architect.read_only_enforcement: Workspace on detached HEAD or separate read-only clone

steps.title: Define auditor prompt template
steps.description: Create prompt template for auditor agents

acceptance_criteria.description: Auditor prompt includes: task description, acceptance criteria, artifacts produced
Prompt instructs auditor to verify each criterion with pass/fail
Prompt instructs use of report_audit_result MCP tool
Template is configurable (can be overridden per project)

specification.pattern_description: Copy prompt template pattern from planner-core

steps.title: Implement read-only workspace for auditor
steps.description: Create read-only access to workspace for auditor

acceptance_criteria.description: createAuditorWorkspace(workerWorkspacePath) returns read-only access
Option 1: git checkout --detach in worker workspace
Option 2: Separate shallow clone with no push remote
Write separate .forge/mcp-config.json for auditor with task_id context

architecture.option_2: Separate worktree with no push remote

steps.title: Implement spawnAuditor function
steps.description: Function to spawn auditor agent for task verification

acceptance_criteria.description: spawnAuditor(taskId, artifacts, criteria) spawns auditor agent
Agent name pattern: audit-run-{runId}-task-{taskId}
Prompt includes artifacts and criteria from task
Timeout shorter than worker (default 10 minutes)
Uses AgentSpawner from forge-relay-integration

specification.pattern_description: Similar to worker spawn but different prompt and role

steps.title: Integrate auditor dispatch after worker completion
steps.description: Trigger auditor spawn when worker reports completion

acceptance_criteria.description: Listen for task status change to 'auditing' (set by report_complete tool)
If step.audit=true or global forge.audit_all=true, spawn auditor
Load artifacts from storage for auditor context
Emit trajectory event 'auditor_spawned'

architecture.audit_trigger: step.audit = true or global config forge.audit_all = true
architecture.integration: Hook on task status change via event listener

steps.title: Handle audit pass result
steps.description: Process successful audit result from report_audit_result tool

acceptance_criteria.description: On audit pass (result='pass'): set task status to 'completed'
Findings already stored by report_audit_result MCP tool handler
Emit trajectory event 'task_completed'
Call scheduler.scheduleReadyTasks(runId) to process dependent tasks

architecture.integration_point: Listen for audit_completed trajectory event with result='pass'

steps.title: Handle audit fail result with retry
steps.description: Process failed audit result with retry logic

acceptance_criteria.description: On audit fail: check if current_attempt < max_attempts
If retries remaining: set task status to 'pending', increment current_attempt
Re-enqueue task with audit findings in context
If no retries: set task status to 'failed' with audit findings
Retry worker prompt includes previous audit findings for correction guidance

architecture.retry_context: Audit findings injected into worker prompt on retry

steps.title: Update workspace context for retry
steps.description: Update .forge/context.json with audit findings for retry

acceptance_criteria.description: On retry, update .forge/context.json with previous_attempt section
previous_attempt includes: audit_findings, worker_output, attempt_number
Worker prompt template shows how to use retry context

architecture.context_update: Append to existing context.json, don't overwrite
